text_block_list.text:
On the way to my office, I hear a shrill
voice—one
that I recognize.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ngh! Impressive, Fuji.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Heh, you as well, Opera O! Your
performance
moved me to my core.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: Uh, is there a show going on?

text_block_list.text:
Yes, dance practice—no! Dare I say, a
dance
battle!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I have added my own personal flair to
the
assigned piece, to create my one
and only
Operatic Dance of Brilliance!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And I, on the other hand, have
maintained the
original choreography in
my Dance of Mighty
Expression!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Whose dance would sway the most
hearts? We
engaged in a duel to answer
that very question.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Since I'm an entertainer of sorts, the
challenge
struck a chord with me. ♪
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Fuji won, hands down! No, Opera O's
dance was
better!
text_block_list.name: Student Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Could this be... a draw? What are we to
do? A
duet would be called for at times
like this in a
play.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Oh! I've got it... Trainer! To the stage!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
A good dance does not only allure, it
entices all
who see it to dance along.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
How right you are! In other words, your
trainer
will choose which of us compels
others to dance
the most.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Precisely! Now, choose! The Operatic
Dance of
Brilliance or the Dance of
Mighty Expression!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: The Operatic Dance of Brilliance, of course.
The Dance of Mighty Expression, I guess!

text_block_list.text:
Consider me one of the many who's been

mesmerized by Т.М. Опера О's unique

perspective!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My dear trainer! I knew you understood
my allure!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Now let us dance! Allow my radiant
presence to
ignite your body and soul!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Three, two, stЭпизод.. Now do a shining
pose! Ready,
and—sha-bliiing!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Hmm, so that is your pose of brilliance! Then... I shall pose like this!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ahh! I must admit defeat! You two are
completely
in sync—on many levels. ♪
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Whew... Superb, Trainer.  It was a fruitful
battle,
to be sure.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The possibilities of dance truly blossom
as a duet.
Your pose of brilliance led me
to realize this.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
In winning concerts, we dance the dance
of
runners. And of course, as the
Overlord, with me
at the center.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I must shimmer with soul fire so as to
illuminate
those who accompany me
onstage—for the
Overlord brings out the
brilliance of others!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: What?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Yes, originality is important, but you
have to
master the fundamentals first.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm honored that you would choose me.
Please,
be gentle!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Yes, wonderful footwork! And...
considerably
cunning of you as well!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Don't tell me you don't feel that
piercing
gaze. You've lit a flame inside
her.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Oh? The song has ended. That was a
joyful little
moment we had. For now, so
long!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Impressive. I felt the potential of
your
expressiveness.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: And yet... you're so timid.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Surely, you felt too bashful to pair with
my
astounding beauty.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Of course, I am the pinnacle of perfection, so you are quite forgiven. But you must steel yourself for next time.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
For when you take this hand, the beauty
of my
dance will have you forget all
those fears!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Not choosing Т.М. Опера О as my
partner has
increased her motivation to
dance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It appears she's learned the importance
of
performing with her fellow dancers
while
expressing herself onstage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
